row.reason: Forestar develops raw land into finished residential lots and sells them to homebuilders. D.R. Horton builds and sells homes to individual homebuyers and adds mortgage and title services. Both serve US single-family housing, so they overlap in end market and in the land-to-lot step. Their main products and customers differ, so this is adjacent, not direct. The comp's own lines show home sales, not lot sales. Forestar's own lines show lots sold to builders, and D.R. Horton is its majority owner.
